dedupe_keys.name: hermes viewer of the spanish general interest transport network airports ports roads railways waterways intermodal terminals with capacity traffic safety and alternative fuel layers

description: HERMES is the Spanish transport ministry's map viewer of the general-interest transport network, bringing airports, ports, roads, railways, waterways and intermodal terminals into one map. The viewer read on 2026-09-28 organises its layers into basic infrastructure, such as the airport catalogue with runways and terminal capacities, the port catalogue, freight terminals with siding lengths, track gauges and electrification, the State Road Network with tunnels, and railway sections with gauge, ERTMS level and electrification; installations and services; network use, including airport and port traffic, average daily road traffic by counting station and section, and big-data origin-destination trips; road safety sections; alternative fuel points; and planned actions with the TEN-T corridors. Coverage is Spain. Access is free on the web; the thematic layers carry no licence in the part read, while the basemaps are credited CC BY 4.0. Caveats: only the layer list was read, no attribute tables or download or service addresses were opened, and whether the layers can be exported is unconfirmed. It supports national transport network studies, such as mapping freight terminals and electrified lines exposed to floods, or modelling rerouting of road traffic when a corridor closes. Related records: the Spanish Transport and Logistics Observatory and the Spanish National Access Point.
